articles.summary: We are delighted to announce that GFL Environmental’s Squamish and Victoria facilities in British Columbia, have been selected as recipients of the Call2Recycle 2025 Leaders in Sustainability Award for their achievements in collecting batteries for recycling. Both facilities have won this award previously, demonstrating their ongoing commitment to waste diversion, responsible battery management and environmental […]
articles.title: GFL Squamish and Victoria named Leaders in Sustainability 2025
